facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock strike, the watch reading of twenty minutes to nine, and the uncle's scene in front of everyone.
Félix goes up to the library after dinner and stays there alone. At the temple's ten strokes his watch reads twenty to ten.
At eighteen minutes past ten by his watch he hears a thump right above him in the atelier, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.
Quarter past ten by his watch: someone goes quickly up the stairs past the library door. Twenty-one past ten: someone comes quickly down. He did not see who; the door was shut.
His aunt's piano is playing downstairs when the thump comes.
Girard enters the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch, and they sit together until the temple strikes eleven.
